faqs.answer:
You can apply for an internship on Internshala using the following steps-
  • Click on 'View Details' to get details about the company and the profile.
  • Go through the details thoroughly and apply for internships where your profile matches the requirements of the company.

Internship Snapshot

Looking for internships? Currently, there are 6922 active internship vacancies from 5965 companies across key sector(s) such as IT/Technology, Advertising/Marketing, Education/Teaching/Training.

Internship Types and Stipend Insights

Internshala offers a variety of internship opportunities to match different work preferences:

  • 6571 full-time internships
  • 1904 part-time internships
  • 3267 work-from-home internships

Stipend Insights for Internships

Stipends for internship roles vary based on experience, skills, and industry demand:

  • For internships: Stipend typically ranges from ₹750 to ₹2,02,000 per month.

Top Companies Hiring for internships

Some of the most active companies currently recruiting for internships include:

  • GRADTWIN SERVICES (OPC) PRIVATE LIMITED: Hiring for role(s) in Education, IT, Data Science
  • Unessa Foundation: Opportunities available in NGO, Volunteering, Computer Science
  • Echotalk: Recruitment ongoing in IT, MBA, Data Science
  • Velozity Global Solutions: Openings for IT, MBA, Marketing
  • Emoolar Technology Private Limited: Actively hiring in Education, Engineering, Computer Science

Explore company pages and apply to verified internship openings directly on Internshala.

Popular Internship Categories

Candidates searching for internship opportunities frequently apply for:

  • MBA
  • Marketing
  • Digital Marketing
  • IT
  • Social Media Marketing

Stay Updated with Internship Alerts

Don't miss out on new internship vacancies. Sign up for free internship alerts to receive the latest openings that match your profile. Stay ahead while finding internships that fit your career goals.
